name: DSA Transparency Database - European Union
snippet:
The database allows to track the content moderation decisions taken by providers of online platforms in almost real-time.
Welcome to the DSA Transparency Database! The Digital Services Act (DSA), obliges providers of hosting services to inform their users of the content moderation decisions they take and explain the reasons behind those decisions in so-called statements of reasons.
